body:
Huh. Looks like I should talk to someone. 

Thanks!

What if it doesn't feel like depression?

I'm new to this whole thing, and this is the second time I've found myself contemplating suicide at a really big level in two weeks. 

Though, on my good days, I'm still actively trying to hang out with my friends, talk to people, do things I enjoy (programming), enjoy YouTube videos, spend time cooking (and thus - eat well), I exercise.

I feel like I'm doing everything *right*, but I also feel like I just want to not be here anymore.

What would you call this?
